mapper.sql: CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT e.calendar_event_id AS id, CASE e.scope_code WHEN 'SCOPE_PERSONAL' THEN 'PERSONAL' WHEN 'SCOPE_COMPANY' THEN 'COMPANY' ELSE 'DEPT' END AS scope, TO_CHAR(e.starts_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "date", e.title AS title, e.content AS memo, e.owner_employee_id AS ownerId, e.event_type AS eventType FROM calendar_event e WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.starts_at >= #{from} AND e.starts_at < #{to} AND (e.event_type IS NULL OR e.event_type != 'EV_LEAVE') AND ( (e.scope_code = 'SCOPE_PERSONAL' AND e.owner_employee_id = #{employeeId}) OR e.scope_code = 'SCOPE_COMPANY') ORDER BY e.starts_at, e.calendar_event_id

SELECT calendar_event_id AS id, CASE scope_code WHEN 'SCOPE_PERSONAL' THEN 'PERSONAL' WHEN 'SCOPE_COMPANY' THEN 'COMPANY' ELSE 'DEPT' END AS scope, owner_employee_id AS ownerId, event_type AS eventType FROM calendar_event WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND calendar_event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calendar_event (company_id, owner_employee_id, scope_code, title, content, starts_at, ends_at, all_day_yn) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{ownerId}, #{scopeCode}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, 'Y')

INSERT INTO calendar_event (company_id, owner_employee_id, scope_code, event_type, title, starts_at, ends_at, all_day_yn, leave_request_day_id) SELECT #{companyId}, #{ownerId}, 'SCOPE_PERSONAL', 'EV_LEAVE', #{title}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{allDayYn}, #{leaveRequestDayId} FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM calendar_event WHERE leave_request_day_id = #{leaveRequestDayId})
